hero_eyebrow: Professional Plasterer — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From blown coatings to new builds, we deliver flawless finishes on time and within budget across Sheffield.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior wall finishing, external rendering, or specialist coatings, we've got the skill and materials to get the job done right.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Boarding
services.desc: Smooth plasterboard finishing, skimming and decoration ready surfaces. Perfect for new rooms, renovations and damp repairs.

services.title: External Rendering & Coatings
services.desc: Durable render systems that protect and beautify your home exterior. We use quality materials suited to Yorkshire's climate.

services.title: Blown Coat Repairs
services.desc: Identify and fix loose or failing plaster before it becomes a bigger problem. We patch and blend seamlessly with existing finishes.

services.title: Artex & Textured Coatings
services.desc: Application and removal of textured finishes. Whether you want modern smooth or period character, we deliver a professional result.

services.title: Dry Lining & Partition Walls
services.desc: Fast, clean installation of stud partitions and board systems — ideal for reconfiguring spaces without structural work.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Feature Walls
services.desc: Polished plaster, venetian finishes, and bespoke decorative treatments for customers who want something beyond standard.

about_pullquote: I built this business on doing the job once, doing it well, and respecting your time.
about_para_1: R M Plastering has been serving Sheffield and surrounding areas for over 18 years. Starting with a simple commitment to honest work and superior finishes, we've grown into one of the region's most trusted plastering specialists. Our reputation rests on reliability, craftsmanship, and a straightforward approach to every project — no shortcuts, no surprises.
about_para_2: Homeowners, builders and property managers choose us because we show up on time, complete work to their schedule, and treat every property as if it were our own. We invest in the best materials and techniques, which means your plaster lasts longer and looks better. Whether it's a single-room renovation or a whole-house remodel, you get the same attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our hallway and stairs replastered after removing old Artex. R M Plastering quoted fair and finished three days ahead of schedule. The finish is immaculate — you wouldn't believe it was ever textured. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Called R M Plastering on a Monday morning because our kitchen render had blown in places. They came out for a free survey that day and started work the following week. Fixed it properly, not a patch job. Good lads, good price.
reviews.author: Michelle P.

reviews.text: First time I've used a plasterer who actually listens to what you want and explains what he's doing. New plasterboard throughout our extension, finish is smooth and ready for paint. Tidy workers too. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Robert K.
